definitions.text_mt: Vojt
Għeluq, ħajja bla skop u nuqqas ta' valur

usage_examples.mt: Wara li telaq, ħassejt frugħa kbira f'qalbi.
usage_examples.en: After he left, I felt a great emptiness in my heart.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frugħa ta' ħajtu kienet tidher f'kull għażla li kien jagħmel.
usage_examples.en: The vanity of his life was evident in every choice he made.

definitions.text_mt: Konfini bejn żewġ pajjiżi jew reġjuni

usage_examples.mt: Il-fruntiera bejn Malta u l-Italja hija baħar miftuħ.
usage_examples.en: The border between Malta and Italy is open sea.

usage_examples.mt: Qasmu l-fruntiera mingħajr ebda problemi.
usage_examples.en: They crossed the frontier without any problems.

definitions.text_mt: Zokkor li jinsab b'mod naturali fil-frott u fl-għasel

usage_examples.mt: Il-fruttożju huwa zokkor naturali li jinsab fil-frott.
usage_examples.en: Fructose is a natural sugar found in fruit.

usage_examples.mt: Xi nies għandhom diffikultà jiddiġerixxu l-fruttożju.
usage_examples.en: Some people have difficulty digesting fructose.

definitions.text_mt: Tagħwiġ ta' xi ħaġa, speċjalment minħabba tgħożż żejjed

usage_examples.mt: Il-fsied ta' dik it-tifel kien evidenti għal kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: The spoiling of that child was evident to everyone.

usage_examples.mt: Bil-fsied kontinwu, tilef kull sens ta' responsabbiltà.
usage_examples.en: With constant pampering, he lost all sense of responsibility.

definitions.text_mt: Ġieb f'moħħu dak li kien jaf jew li ġara qabel

usage_examples.mt: Ma nistax niftakar x'ġara lbieraħ filgħaxija.
usage_examples.en: I cannot remember what happened yesterday evening.

usage_examples.mt: Ftakar li tixtri l-ħalib meta tmur il-ħanut.
usage_examples.en: Remember to buy milk when you go to the shop.

usage_examples.mt: Dejjem niftakar il-jiem sbieħ li qattajna flimkien.
usage_examples.en: I always remember the beautiful days we spent together.

definitions.text_mt: Ġibja f'moħħ il-memorja ta' xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftakir ta' dik il-mument kien iġiblu dmuugħ għal għajnejh.
usage_examples.en: The remembrance of that moment used to bring tears to his eyes.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftakir tal-ġenituri huwa importanti fil-kultura Maltija.
usage_examples.en: The remembrance of parents is important in Maltese culture.

definitions.text_mt: Tmiem tat-treddigħ tat-trabi

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftam tat-tarbija seħħ meta kellha tmintax-il xahar.
usage_examples.en: The weaning of the baby occurred when she was eighteen months old.

usage_examples.mt: Mhux dejjem faċli li wieħed jgħaddi mill-proċess tal-ftam.
usage_examples.en: It is not always easy to go through the process of weaning.

definitions.text_mt: Tmiem tat-treddigħ u waqfien mill-ħalib tas-sider

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftama kienet deċiżjoni diffiċli għall-omm.
usage_examples.en: The weaning was a difficult decision for the mother.

usage_examples.mt: Matul il-ftama, it-tarbija bdiet tiekol ikel solidu.
usage_examples.en: During weaning, the baby started eating solid food.

definitions.text_mt: Iċċekkja bir-reqqa biex jara li kollox kien sew

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġenerali ftaqad lit-truppi qabel il-battalja.
usage_examples.en: The general inspected the troops before the battle.

usage_examples.mt: Ftaqad id-dokument kollu qabel ma ffirmah.
usage_examples.en: He inspected the whole document before signing it.

definitions.text_mt: Spezzjoni bir-reqqa ta' xi ħaġa

usage_examples.mt: Wara ftaqid bir-reqqa, sabu l-iżball.
usage_examples.en: After a careful inspection, they found the mistake.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftaqid tal-bini dam sagħtejn.
usage_examples.en: The inspection of the building lasted two hours.

definitions.text_mt: Tkellem b'kburija kbira dwaru nnifsu

usage_examples.mt: Jiftaħar bil-karozza l-ġdida li xtara.
usage_examples.en: He boasts about the new car he bought.

usage_examples.mt: Tieqaf tiftaħar daqshekk, għax ma togħġob lil ħadd.
usage_examples.en: Stop boasting so much, because nobody likes it.

definitions.text_mt: Kburija u tkabbir żejjed bi ħwejjeġ li wieħed għamel jew għandu

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftaħir tiegħu kien idejjaq lil kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: His boasting annoyed everyone.

usage_examples.mt: M'hemm xejn ħażin f'ftaħir żgħir meta tagħmel xi ħaġa tajba.
usage_examples.en: There is nothing wrong with a little boasting when you do something good.

definitions.text_mt: Sar mifhum jew ċar bejn żewġ naħat jew aktar

usage_examples.mt: Fl-aħħar ftehmu wara ġlieda twila.
usage_examples.en: They finally came to an understanding after a long fight.

usage_examples.mt: Ma nistax niftehem ma' xi ħadd li ma jismax.
usage_examples.en: I cannot come to an understanding with someone who does not listen.

definitions.text_mt: Qbil bejn żewġ naħat jew aktar

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftehim kien iffirmat miż-żewġ partijiet.
usage_examples.en: The agreement was signed by both parties.

usage_examples.mt: Waslu għal ftehim wara ġimgħat ta' negozjati.
usage_examples.en: They reached an agreement after weeks of negotiations.

usage_examples.mt: Dan il-ftehim huwa ta' benefiċċju għal kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: This deal is beneficial for everyone.

definitions.text_en: mediopassive of feraq: to be separated
definitions.text_mt: Infired minn ħaddieħor u ma baqax flimkien
Infired u ma baqax jgħix jew jaħdem ma' ħaddieħor

usage_examples.mt: It-tnejn li huma fterqu wara ħmistax-il sena flimkien.
usage_examples.en: The two of them separated after fifteen years together.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħbieb fterqu meta marru jgħixu f'pajjiżi differenti.
usage_examples.en: The friends separated when they went to live in different countries.

definitions.text_mt: Wasal għal qbil ma' ħaddieħor

definitions.text_en: to reach an agreement or deal
definitions.text_mt: Għamel ftehim ma' xi ħadd wara diskussjoni

usage_examples.mt: Ftiehmu li jaqsmu l-flus indaqs.
usage_examples.en: They agreed to share the money equally.

usage_examples.mt: Wara ħafna diskussjoni, fl-aħħar ftiehmu.
usage_examples.en: After much discussion, they finally reached an agreement.

definitions.text_mt: Biċċiet irqaq tal-ħobż

usage_examples.mt: Poġġi l-ftiet tal-ħobż fuq il-mejda mal-ġobon.
usage_examples.en: Put the slices of bread on the table with the cheese.

usage_examples.mt: Kiel ftiet tal-ħobż mal-brodu sħun.
usage_examples.en: He ate slices of bread with the hot broth.

definitions.text_mt: Spag jew ħajt li jaqbad biex in-nar jibqa' mixgħul f'apparat tad-dawl

usage_examples.mt: Biddel il-ftila taż-żejt qabel ma nqatgħet kompletament.
usage_examples.en: He changed the oil wick before it burned out completely.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftila tax-xemgħa kienet qasira wisq u n-nar intfew.
usage_examples.en: The candle wick was too short and the flame went out.

definitions.text_mt: Waqfien mit-treddigħ tat-trabi

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftim kellu jsir bil-mod il-mod biex it-tarbija tadatta.
usage_examples.en: The weaning had to be done slowly so the baby could adapt.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-ftim, it-tarbija bdiet torqod aħjar.
usage_examples.en: After weaning, the baby started sleeping better.

definitions.text_mt: Fetqien u qsim ta' xi ħaġa li kiet magħluqa

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftiq tal-purtiera seħħ minħabba l-pressjoni kbira.
usage_examples.en: The bursting of the curtain happened because of the great pressure.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-ftiq, l-ilma nfirex mal-art kollha.
usage_examples.en: After the burst, the water spread across the whole floor.

definitions.text_mt: Tkissir ta' xi ħaġa fi biċċiet żgħar

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftir tal-ħobż frisk għamilna frak fuq il-mejda.
usage_examples.en: The crumbling of the fresh bread left crumbs on the table.

usage_examples.mt: Bil-ftir tal-ġebel, irnexxielhom jibnu t-triq il-ġdida.
usage_examples.en: By crushing the stone, they managed to build the new road.

definitions.text_en: a kind of flat, usually ring -shaped bread, often used for sandwiches
definitions.text_mt: Ħobż ċatt u tond, ħafna drabi b'toqba fin-nofs jew mimli bil-ħwawar
Xi ħaġa ċatta jew iċċattjata
Taħwida jew sitwazzjoni mhux f'lokuha

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftira Maltija hija mimlija bit-tewm u ż-żejt taż-żebbuġa.
usage_examples.en: The Maltese ftira is filled with garlic and olive oil.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-inkwiet, id-dar kollha kienet ftira waħda.
usage_examples.en: After the trouble, the whole house was a mess.

usage_examples.mt: Għafas il-ballun sakemm sar ftira.
usage_examples.en: He squeezed the ball until it became completely flat.

definitions.text_mt: Numru żgħir ta' affarijiet jew persuni
Ammont żgħir ta' xi ħaġa

usage_examples.mt: Ftit nies biss attendew il-laqgħa lbieraħ.
usage_examples.en: Only a few people attended the meeting yesterday.

usage_examples.mt: Għandu ftit flus biss fil-but.
usage_examples.en: He has only a little money in his pocket.

definitions.text_mt: Kemmxein jew mhux ħafna

usage_examples.mt: Kellem ftit waqt il-pranzu.
usage_examples.en: He spoke little during dinner.

usage_examples.mt: Stenna ftit u mbagħad ibda.
usage_examples.en: Wait a little and then start.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa ftit magħruf barra minn xtutna.
usage_examples.en: He is little known outside our shores.

definitions.text_mt: Ftuħ ta' xi ħaġa li kienet magħluqa

usage_examples.mt: Il-ftiħ tal-bieb ħalla d-dawl jidħol fil-kamra.
usage_examples.en: The opening of the door let the light enter the room.

usage_examples.mt: Kull ftiħ ta' tieqa kien iġib arja friska.
usage_examples.en: Every opening of a window would bring in fresh air.
